column7: Renew, reload web server, monitor expiry.

column7: Fix NTP; Kerberos allows only 5 minutes skew.

column5: Ticket: Cron job did not run
column7: PATH, permissions or % escaping; docs/16-cron-scenarios.md.

column5: Ticket: Docker host disk full
column6: docker system df; docker system prune
column7: Old images and logs; set log rotation in daemon.json.

column5: Ticket: Domain names do not resolve
column6: resolvectl status; dig ya.ru; dig @8.8.8.8 ya.ru
column7: runbooks/dns-failure.md.

column5: Ticket: High memory usage and OOM kills
column6: free -h; ps aux --sort=-%mem | head; journalctl -k | grep -i oom
column7: Find the leak, set MemoryMax, add swap if needed.

column5: Ticket: Host unreachable alert from monitoring
column6: ping host; ip neigh; ssh host; check console
column7: Network, firewall or host down; escalate with facts.

column5: Ticket: Login to directory account fails
column6: realm list; systemctl status sssd; sudo sss_cache -E
column7: SSSD cache or domain trust problem.

column5: Ticket: No space left on device
column6: df -h; df -i; sudo du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -h | tail; sudo lsof +L1
column7: runbooks/disk-full.md.

column5: Ticket: Package install fails with lock error (Ubuntu)
column7: Wait for unattended-upgrades; never delete the lock blindly.

column5: Ticket: Permission denied on a shared folder
column7: Check groups, mode, ACL and SELinux context.

column5: Ticket: Server is slow
column7: Check load vs cores, IO wait and swap; runbooks/high-load.md.

column5: Ticket: Server went into emergency mode after reboot
column7: Usually a bad fstab line; docs/24-boot-recovery.md.

column5: Ticket: Service fails to start after config change
column6: systemctl status SERVICE; journalctl -u SERVICE -n 50; nginx -t
column7: Validate config syntax and read the first error.

column5: Ticket: Too many open files
column6: systemctl show SERVICE -p LimitNOFILE; ls /proc/PID/fd | wc -l
column7: Raise LimitNOFILE in a drop-in; docs/25-performance-tuning.md.

column5: Ticket: User cannot SSH in

column7: runbooks/ssh-access.md.

column5: Ticket: Website returns 502 Bad Gateway
column6: systemctl status nginx; journalctl -u nginx -n 50; ss -tlnp | grep -E ':80|:8080'
column7: Backend is down or Nginx cannot reach it; see runbooks/service-down.md.
